name: create_artifact
description: Create an artifact preview from the chat workspace mounted at /work. The tool snapshots the selected Agent VM workspace when vm_id is provided, otherwise the resolved chat workspace root, then starts the preview server inside an Agent VM Docker container and displays it in the Electron panel only after startup validation succeeds.

chat_id.description: The chat session ID that will own this artifact

name.description: Display name for the artifact (e.g., 'Calculator App')

start_command.description: Command to start the web server (e.g., 'npm run dev', 'python -m http.server 5173')

container_port.description: Port the server runs on inside the container (default: 5173 for Vite)

vm_id.description: Optional source Agent VM GUID to snapshot from. If omitted, snapshots the resolved chat workspace root.

name: create_artifact_version
description: Create a new version of an artifact by snapshotting the selected Agent VM /work workspace, then restart the artifact preview inside an Agent VM Docker container.

source_vm_id.description: VM ID to snapshot from (use your development VM from agent_vm_create)

version_note.description: Short description of changes (max 50 chars, e.g., 'Added dark mode', 'Fixed layout')

name: open_artifact
description: Open an artifact in the Electron panel. Starts the server if needed and signals Electron to display the preview. Always auto-opens when called.

version.description: Specific version to view (default: current version)

detached.description: Open in a separate window instead of side panel

force_restart.description: Restart the artifact runtime even when its container still appears healthy

name: switch_artifact_version
description: Switch a running artifact to a different version. Restores the snapshot for that version and restarts the server.

version.description: The version number to switch to

name: list_artifacts
description: List all artifacts for a chat session.

include_all_versions.description: Include full version history for each artifact

name: get_artifact_status
description: Get detailed status of an artifact including preview URL, version info, and running state.

name: close_artifact
description: Close the artifact panel and stop the server. Releases resources but preserves the artifact and its versions.

name: delete_artifact
description: Permanently delete an artifact and all its versions. This cannot be undone.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion

name: restore_artifact_version
description: Restore an artifact to a previous version. This replaces the current working state with the snapshot from the specified version.

name: download_artifact
description: Export an artifact version as a .tar.gz archive into the resolved chat workspace for download.

name: get_artifact_running_versions
description: Get all running versions and their ports for an artifact. Returns the server pool status including which versions are hot (instantly switchable) and which would require cold restoration.
